answer: Bind each agent key to one active payroll record: the payroll provider signs a fresh challenge confirming the job, so a key cannot wander between employments and one record backs exactly one identity. Forging 1,000 agents means fabricating 1,000 jobs — about $500 each in payroll tax, filings and admin, roughly $500,000 — and the gale of tax-office audits that follows would expose the entire comet of fake workers in one sweep.
